notes.title: Rhythm Hotel Update Log: Ver 0.3.2-beta
notes.content:
Dear players,



We’ve received feedback that some players were unable to launch the game. 

After investigation, we’ve identified the cause and fixed the bug. 

The update is now live. Many thanks to everyone who reported the problem! 🙏



🛠 Patch Notes:

1. Fixed a crash caused by the delayed initialization order of the multi-language manager

2. Added function to switch social media interface automatically based on system language



Thank you all for your continuous support and feedback. 

Have fun with the rhythm!

notes.title: Rhythm Hotel Update Log: Ver1.3.3.2-beta
notes.content:
Dear Rhythm Hotel Travelers,



Though our hotel is still under construction, our relentless pursuit of quality has led us to open 3 trial rooms for you. Some travelers have already experienced them and provided valuable feedback, which we’re actively compiling.Below are the adjustments and optimizations made to certain rooms and systems:


Update
New Oath of the Peach Garden Room: Increased prompt sound volume by 20%.

Philosophy on Donkey-kicking Room: Optimized select rhythm patterns.


Bugs Fixed
Fixed background music looping issues in the lobby and room corridors.

Disabled debugging functions.

Removed spaceship debug messages.





Updates will roll out on a rolling basis. 

We’re accelerating the inn’s construction to open for business soon! 

Stay connected with us via our official Discord!
